Name: Phoenix Wright and Pearl Fey Character replacement  (UPDATED FOR 1.1)
Author: Zalkyrion
Description:
[b][center][b]Note as of 2/8/17 - I was reported about a bug with the mail.xnb file. Considering the game chooses the mail at random and perhaps changing Harvey's name causes this but it will cause the game to crash. I do not know how to fix this so until further notice I will recommend replacing the xnb with the original file. Sorry in advance for those that had their game crash.

UPDATED for 1.1 - I noticed Harvey got some new sprites so with DivineJustice's help since my computer was down, I was able to update his sprite. [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/blooper8484.647414/]@Blooper8484[/url] also helped us update Pearl's as well. Also since I had to update the files, I went ahead and include the name change for Pearl.[/b]

[b]Another addition to this mod is there is now a character development with Pearl Fey, which will have one that will be compatible with DivineJustice's character replacements mod and another where it will just have Phoenix and Pearl. I would like to thank [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/randomanon123.669377/]@randomAnon123[/url] for giving me permission to use his mod with Pearl![/b][/center][/b][center]
So as the title suggests, this is a character replacement of Harvey. I wasn't too found of Harvey's design at first and decided to attempt to make a Phoenix Wright sprite. I was surprised with how well the sprite came out, and much to my surprise how well Phoenix Wright fits Harvey in general. So I've decided to share this wonderful treasure with everyone here, and yes I even did my best to swap out Harvey's name with Phoenix. There are some parts where Harvey will come up, but I don't really know what else I can edit.
An added bonus, my friend had made a wonderful Portrait replacement for Jas. She is now Pearl Fey, and she looks adorable~! [/center]

[center][b][/b][b]Also if you would like to check out [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/divinejustice.679500/]@DivineJustice[/url] mod, Link will be below this. Also the portraits have now become Portraiture compatible, so if you are familiar with the mod Portraiture will be on DivineJustice's mod as well.
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/characters-replaced-coming-soon.121637/]http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/characters-replaced-coming-soon.121637/

[/url][/b][b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/characters-replaced-coming-soon.121637/][/url][/b][b]Please follow this link for the full mod and only replace my edited files so Pearl's name will show up during the events. Also if you so happen to be using DivinveJustice's mod as well, I have included the files that will be compatible with that mod, but again download [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/randomanon123.669377/]@randomAnon123[/url]'s mod [/b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/jas-events-mod-or-character-development-for-jas.125502/]Download full mod here[/url][/center]
[i][center]
A word from DivineJustice: I have noticed that reading from these forums that a few people don't like characters changing like this. Just a note, this is MERELY for fun. Being a big Phoenix fangirl, I just saw how Harvey fits Phoenix so well. And Pearl as well with Jas. It's fine if anyone wants to use these but again, this isn't to replace Harvey or Jas in any way. I also plan on changing up other characters in the future. Thank you![/center][/i]
